1.consolidated_definition: Tortuga terrestre de hasta 75 cm de longitud, de caparazón alto y muy convexo, de color negro con placas óseas octogonales y abultadas de color amarillo anaranjado o naranja rojizo, cabeza, cuello, patas y cola negras con escamas amarillentas. Testudinidae, Geochelone carbonaria, G. denticulata.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Land tortoise of up to 75 cm in length, with a high and very convex carapace, black in color with octagonal and swollen osseous plates of yellow-orange or reddish orange hue, head, neck, legs, and tail black with yellowish scales. Family Testudinidae, Geochelone carbonaria, G. denticulata.
